```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

antibiotics <- read_csv("Antibiotic Consumption Data.csv")
```
```{r}
gt(head(antibiotics))
```

```{r}
ggplot(antibiotics, aes(x = date, y = metric_value)) + 
  geom_line(colour = 'steelblue', linewidth = 1.5) + 
  labs(title = "Antibiotic consumption over time", x = "Date", y = "Metric value of consumption") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12, ink = "slateblue4", paper = "#f2f0ef") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"))
```
